arms.description: Minimal PI-style perceive-act loop: model call, tool execution, observation append, no candle-cli context/memory/subagent enhancements.

scenarios.goal: Inspect python/migration/trace_capture.py and its tests. Explain the exact guard that prevents Python bool values from being summarized as integers and name the boolean ValueKind.
Inspect the migration mapping and scanner code. Explain how an API with no MindSpore mapping is represented without inventing an operator.
Inspect python/migration/trace_compare.py. Explain how the first tensor shape divergence is classified and reported.
Inspect python/migration/advanced_training.py. Explain how GRAPH_MODE compile failures are distinguished from runtime failures.
Inspect the advanced-training evaluator and checked-in result. Identify the AdamW failure category without claiming a framework bug.
Inspect the advanced-training checkpoint validation. State how the report proves that save and restore happened in different processes.
Inspect python/migration/data_pipeline.py. Distinguish deterministic sequence equality from statistical distribution equivalence.
Inspect the trace comparison implementation and explain which field identifies the earliest semantic mismatch.
Inspect the migration workflow rollback path. Explain which report field confirms that recovery completed successfully.
Inspect the real-model dual-runtime benchmark summary. Distinguish automatic from manual patch accounting.
